response.rationale: Both answers accurately express the target sense. Ceroboh is established in Indonesian for careless, incautious, or imprecise behavior, while Malaysian Malay cuai means careless or negligent. The relation different-common-word is valid as a contrast between the selected forms, without implying exclusivity. No false-friend contrast is present or required; the two forms are overlapping synonyms across varieties.
